featured_reviews.name: Freny Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Got a hair color done here from Sameer itself after looking at their Instagram. Will not make that mistake again. Inspite of showing references of clearly warm shades, he did a ash color on me. Which is still forgivable. But I clearly told him about my previous experience with bleach and how damaged my hair gets after.
And specifically said that I wanted to add Olaplex, he gave some 2 or 3 reasons why they don’t have it and can’t use it because it doesn’t work well with ash colors and said I should get a additional protein treatment done which gives the same result. That didn’t work at all, my hair is so damaged that it takes 30 mins to take the knots off after each wash. I’m losing a bunch of hair everytime I comb it.

Hair color also seems like it’s only done for their Instagram, something that’ll look good in their videos and for about a week later. Now my hair looks dull, knotted, damaged and yellow! Paid 20k for this btw! Plus they made me buy 5k worth of products and now I ended up buying 10k worth of products to reverse the damage done to my hair. Plus spent around 10k more in just a month for hair spas and toning elsewhere. All in a all a total disaster!!!
Also I’m not one to just write bad reviews without reaching out first. But their response was “just condition the hair. If you want you can come and we’ll show you how to wash & take the knots out”

What!! They were actually sweet and worked on my hair for almost 6-7 hours. But what’s the point if this is the result! It’s not a bad meal or piece of clothing that I can just forget about. It’s literally my hair!

I had a really lovely experience at Glam Salon and wanted to specially appreciate Arshad and Neha for their excellent service. My hair felt much cleaner, softer, lighter and smoother after the spa, and the stickiness that was bothering me was greatly reduced. My hair also looked fluffier and healthier afterward.
What I appreciated most was how gentle and attentive they were throughout the process. They did not rush, explained what they were doing, and made me feel reassured. It felt like they cared about improving the condition of my hair rather than just completing a service.💕
